# World of Chips

> Potato chips from 28 countries: the top brands, popular and unusual flavors, snacking culture and where to buy them online, from Japan’s Calbee to Mexico’s Takis.

World of Chips is an independent guide to potato chip culture around the world: leading brands, popular and unique flavors, snacking occasions and where to buy chips from 28 countries, plus buyer's guides and chip news. Some links are Amazon affiliate links (World of Chips earns from qualifying purchases).

## Main

- [World of Chips: Global Chip Map](https://worldofchips.com/): Interactive world map and overview of every country guide.
- [Potato Chip News: New Flavors, Recalls & Industry Moves](https://worldofchips.com/news/): Potato chip and crisps news from around the world, updated weekly: new flavor launches, food-safety recalls, industry deals and regional snack trends. Updated 20 Oct 2026.

## Flavour pages

- [Prawn Cocktail Chips: Where They Came From & Where to Buy](https://worldofchips.com/flavors/prawn-cocktail/): Prawn cocktail crisps are a sweet, tangy, tomato-and-seafood-sauce flavour and a fixture of British crisp aisles. Sourced history, the countries that love it, and where to buy prawn cocktail chips online.
- [Ketchup Chips: Where They Came From & Where to Buy](https://worldofchips.com/flavors/ketchup/): Ketchup chips are Canada’s signature flavour: tangy-sweet tomato, sugar and vinegar, closer to “inspired by ketchup” than the real thing. Sourced history, the countries that love it, and where to buy ketchup chips online.
- [Salt & Vinegar Chips: Where They Came From & Where to Buy](https://worldofchips.com/flavors/salt-and-vinegar/): Salt & vinegar is the sharp, mouth-puckering classic, and in Britain it’s inseparable from fish and chips. Sourced history, the countries that love it, and where to buy salt & vinegar chips online.
- [Sour Cream & Onion Chips: Where They Came From & Where to Buy](https://worldofchips.com/flavors/sour-cream-and-onion/): Sour cream & onion is creamy, tangy and oniony, and one of the best-selling chip flavours from the US to Scandinavia. Sourced history, the countries that love it, and where to buy sour cream & onion chips online.
- [Paprika Chips: Where They Came From & Where to Buy](https://worldofchips.com/flavors/paprika/): Paprika chips are mild, sweet-smoky and red-dusted, and continental Europe’s answer to cheese & onion. Sourced history, the countries that love it, and where to buy paprika chips online.
- [Nori / Seaweed Chips: Where They Came From & Where to Buy](https://worldofchips.com/flavors/nori-seaweed/): Nori chips, Japan’s norishio (seaweed and salt), are savoury and oceanic, with flecks of green laver. Sourced history, the countries that love it, and where to buy nori / seaweed chips online.
- [BBQ Chips: Where They Came From & Where to Buy](https://worldofchips.com/flavors/bbq/): Barbecue chips are smoky, sweet and savoury, and America’s oldest flavoured chip. Sourced history, the countries that love it, and where to buy bbq chips online.
- [Dill Pickle Chips: Where They Came From & Where to Buy](https://worldofchips.com/flavors/dill-pickle/): Dill pickle chips are vinegary, garlicky and herby: a North American cult favourite. Sourced history, the countries that love it, and where to buy dill pickle chips online.
- [Flamin’ Hot Chips: Where They Came From & Where to Buy](https://worldofchips.com/flavors/flamin-hot/): Flamin’ Hot is Frito-Lay’s red-dusted chilli seasoning, used on Cheetos, Lay’s, Ruffles, Doritos and more. Sourced history, the countries that love it, and where to buy flamin’ hot chips online.
- [Cheese & Onion Chips: Where They Came From & Where to Buy](https://worldofchips.com/flavors/cheese-and-onion/): Cheese & onion is where flavoured crisps began, and it’s still Britain’s favourite. Sourced history, the countries that love it, and where to buy cheese & onion chips online.
